audit.recode_to: Replace the 1968-based 'fixed-dominant, rule 1 10 010 0010 00100 000100 0000100 (penult ≤4σ / antepenult ≥5σ), no secondary stress' with a right-edge FINAL / root-final system: dominant register = primary stress on the final syllable of the (root/stem) word with enclitics (=a NMLZ, bound pronouns, postpositions) extrametrical, i.e. rule 1 01 001 0001 00001... over the stress domain, plus alternating secondary stress leftward per A&A 1984 §5A; strict register = morphologically/lexically conditioned (stress-neutral -an and negation circumfix vs stress-attracting -ahim/-uhu/-ʔi/-ʔa; lexical penult set in -ma/-na/-ŋa; final onsetless-V syllables skipped) — cite A&A 1984:§5 (Sér. Ling. 11, pp.157-174) and dos Santos 2024:40-41; domain = word minus enclitics (fixes the UNCODED domain). Keep Abrahamson 1968 Içuã Tupi as a historical note on a possibly distinct, extinct Kawahíva idiolect pair (its speakers' 'tribal name not known', informant killed BY the Júma), and fold the duplicate key name_icuatupi into this row.
